name: 12-Week Kettlebell Progression (Scaled)

items: 20 easy swings with the 20 lb bell
Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch, 45s per side

rules: Stop each set 2 reps short of where form would break.
Bell stops at chest height. No overhead.
Ribs down, sharp exhale at the top of every rep.
If the lower back rounds, the set is over.
Bail-out: drop to the 20 lb bell and finish clean.
